dc_description_s: This data represents railroads for the City of Oshkosh, Wisconsin in 2026. [Overview This data provides railroad line features. It supports viewing and using railroad infrastructure records in GIS applications for transportation reference, planning, and spatial analysis. Feature Layer Railroads: A line layer representing railroad segments. The layer includes a feature identifier, a tag field, and stored shape length information. Geographic Coverage The service covers a regional area in Wisconsin. Use Cases Transportation and infrastructure mapping Rail network reference and visualization Regional planning and asset review Cartographic display of railroad corridors]
uw_supplemental_s: This is an archived copy of the data held at UW-Madison.
